feed.title: NPR Topics: Business
feed.subtitle: Find the latest business news with reports on Wall Street, interest rates, banking, companies, and U.S. and world financial markets. Subscribe to the Business Story of the Day podcast.

entry.title: Farmers say they'll take the relief of Trump's EO — but they're still hurting
entry.summary: President Trump says his Monday executive order temporarily suspending federal taxes on diesel will be a big relief for farmers. Some farmers call it a campaign ploy with marginal impact.

entry.title: 2 Americans win Nobel Prize in economics for work on boom-bust cycles
entry.summary: Two Americans have won the Nobel Prize in economics for their work on how to smooth boom-and-bust cycles to limit unemployment and inflation.

entry.title: Justice Department investigates TV networks, citing possible anti-trust violations
entry.summary: The move escalates Trump's fight with the press amid court battle over barring CNN, Politico and MS NOW from the White House.

entry.title: It's taking longer to find a new job after losing one
entry.summary: People who lose their jobs in this economy are taking longer to find new work. Nearly four in ten people exhaust their unemployment benefits before they land a new job.

entry.title: Kalshi taps former FBI agent to fight against money laundering
entry.summary: The prediction market company says it wants to prevent its platform from being abused by criminals. The company is facing mounting pressure over market manipulation and insider trading on the site.

entry.title: Fired OpenAI employees question the company's commitment to safety
entry.summary: The three fired workers say OpenAI punished them for being outspoken about safety. The company disputes the claims and says they were fired over mishandling sensitive information.

entry.title: How the beverage aisle got so wild
entry.summary: Planet Money traced many new beverage flavors to one laboratory that serves dozens of companies to see how new flavors are created and why we're seeing such an explosion of options right now.

entry.title: Despite the controversy, data centers could be attractive to struggling rural towns
entry.summary: There's lots of debate over data centers and where they should be located. In a struggling rural town data center development can look a lot more attractive.

entry.title: How the oil industry is preparing for Hurricane Isaias
entry.summary: Hurricane Isaias is this season's first Atlantic hurricane, and is on a path to hit the northern Gulf Coast. How is the oil industry preparing?

entry.title: Why American investors love European defense startups
entry.summary: As European defense spending takes off, just about half of the funding in Europe's defense tech industry is coming from American investors this year. One reason why: European investment firms have restrictions on how they can invest.
